panchakarma_protocols._note: Chapters 28-30 cover Sastra-karma (Surgery), Ksara-karma (Caustic Alkalies), and Agni-karma (Thermal Cautery) — classical para-surgical interventions of Ayurveda, distinct from but complementary to the 5 main Panchakarma procedures.

sastrakarma.definition: Surgical intervention using sharp instruments (sastra) for management of swelling, abscess, ulcer, and wounds when medical treatment fails.
sastrakarma.primary_indication: In both exogenous and endogenous diseases, if medical treatment fails, surgical therapy is indicated.

sopha_classification._label: Classification of Swelling (Sopha) — prerequisite knowledge for surgical timing

types.name: Ama Sopha
features: Mild temperature at region of swelling
types.treatment: Do NOT incise; manage with dosha-specific measures

types.name: Pacyamana Sopha
features: Discoloration and redness; swelling resembles urinary bladder filled with air
Splitting pain all over body, yawning, inflammation
Anorexia, burning sensation, thirst, fever, insomnia
Melting of solid ghee placed on the region; tenderness
Tingling sensation similar to mustard paste application
Crawling sensation of ants on region
Sensation of being squeezed, pinched, beaten with sticks
Pricking with needles; excised by sharp instruments sensation

types.name: Pakva Sopha
features: Swelling becomes passionless; skin loses elasticity and develops wrinkles
Pitting by pressure that fills quickly
Pus moves inside wound similar to water in a leather bag
Itching; disappearance of earlier acute symptoms

types.name: Ati Pakva Sopha
features: Excessive pus formation; cavity forms inside wound
Hair fall at site of wound

raktapaka.name: Raktapaka
features: Very hard in touch — like stone

tridosha_swelling_relationship.Pitta: Responsible for burning sensation in swelling
tridosha_swelling_relationship.Rakta: Responsible for redness and pus formation
tridosha_swelling_relationship.principle: Complete swelling formation requires all three doshas together with Rakta (blood)

general: Elevated swelling due to accumulation of pus in wound
Swelling located at vital points (marma) and joints
incision_contraindications.alternative_in_contraindicated_cases: Use Darana — opening by caustic alkalies and other methods

steps: Ask patient to eat food of his desire
Give concentrated alcohol drinks (provides analgesia; prevents fainting)
food_before_surgery_exception: Irregular position of foetus in the womb
preoperative_care.note: Food is given before surgery in ALL conditions except the above four

equipment_required: Cotton, cloth piece, leaves, thread, bark
Water pots, warm water, cold water
steps: Patient sits or lies on cot facing east
Surgeon gives incision with sharp blade deeply into wound in downward direction
Remove instrument from body in one motion

incision_rules.length: 2 inches per incision for large suppuration areas
incision_rules.probing: Use probe, index finger, or lotus stalk to find pus path before incising
incision_rules.principle: Give adequate incision wherever pus is accumulated; no residual dosha should remain

ideal_surgeon_qualities: Hands do not shake during surgery

horizontal_incision.unsuitable_areas: All areas not in the above list — risk of cutting veins and tendons

immediate_steps: Give cold water for drinking; sprinkle over face
Wash wound with decoctions; clean well
Medicated fumigation with guggulu, aguru, siddhartha (white mustard), hingu, sarjarasa, saindhava lavana, vaca, nimbapatra — all mixed with ghee
Introduce gauze pack into wound — drugs mixed with honey, ghee, sesamum oil
Cover surface with thick plaster of barley flour
Bandage wound with long clean cloth (clockwise or anti-clockwise); knot must NOT be over wound
wound_protection: Protect from insects and flies by oblations
If pain is severe: apply paste of yastimadhu mixed with ghee on wound
Sprinkle water with leaves and white mustard seeds around patient's bed
Fumigate room and bed twice daily

wholesome_foods.item: Mutton soup from desert-dwelling animals (mriga jati)

post_surgery_diet.dietary_principle: Food should be limited, timely, wholesome, and easily digestible. Indigestion → Vata vitiation → swelling, pain, suppuration, burning, abdominal distension.

contraindicated_foods.english: Alcoholic drinks (strong, hot, dry, sour types)
contraindicated_foods.reason: Causes acute complications in persons with ulcers

physical_care: Fan wound with bunch of animal tail hair or with usira grass
Do not beat, poke, or scratch wound with nails
Keep patient engaged in listening to stories, company of friends, elders, brahmins

dressing_schedule.caution: Do NOT open bandage on 2nd day — causes severe pain, tumor formation, delayed healing

gauze_pack_qualities.ideal: Not too unctuous, not too dry; not too thick, not too thin
gauze_pack_qualities.too_dry_effect: Muscle tear, severe pain, lacerations, bleeding

vikesika_wick.description: Special type of wick for fast healing

infected_wound_management.follow_up: Bathe with ksarodaka (alkaline solution) or scarify muscle tissue for quick healing

contraindications_during_recovery: No daytime sleep (causes swelling, itching, redness, pain, pus increase)
No sexual activity or even remembrance/touch/vision of a partner (causes ejaculation, ill effects)
Direct copulation results in death (per text)

suturing_sivana.indications: Traumatic, fresh, and wide wounds of suitable regions
suitable_regions: Wounds caused by vitiation of fat (Meda)
Places without movement and with good musculature
contraindicated_regions: Wounds with foreign bodies in blood
procedure_steps: Remove pieces of bone, grass, hair, dust, clotted blood
Set bones and joints at proper place

post_suturing_care.apply: Powders of srotonjana, ash of hemp, phalini/priyahgu, sallaki, lodhra, yastimadhu — mixed with honey and ghee

suturing_sivana.dry_wound_suturing: If edges have no blood: scrape and induce bleeding, then suture — blood is needed for healing

material_properties.use: When fatty tissue and Kapha accumulate — for scraping

material_properties.material: Metallic plates, leather, bark, bamboo splints

fifteen_types.name: Kosa
fifteen_types.region: Joints of thumb and fingers; stumps after amputation

fifteen_types.name: Svastika
fifteen_types.region: Joints; space between toes; inter-mammary region; glabellum; plantar and palmar surfaces; ears; shoulder dislocation

fifteen_types.name: Dama
fifteen_types.region: Tied around a part for relief of pain or cramps

fifteen_types.name: Anuvellita
fifteen_types.region: Limbs; oblique/deep/large knife cuts; fracture of ribs

fifteen_types.name: Sthagika
fifteen_types.region: Ends of thumb, fingers, penis (encloses splint and drug pastes)

fifteen_types.name: Yamaka
fifteen_types.region: Pair of ulcers on a part (pair of circular bandages)

fifteen_types.name: Mandala
fifteen_types.region: Round parts — arms, sides, abdomen, thighs, back

fifteen_types.name: Pancangi
fifteen_types.region: Parts above clavicle; dislocations of lower jaw

vata_kapha_wounds.rule: Increase tightness by one level compared to standard
vata_kapha_wounds.dressing_removal_schedule: Once in 3 days during Hemanta, Sisira, Vasanta rtu

pitta_rakta_wounds.rule: Decrease tightness by one level compared to standard (if loose was prescribed, omit bandage entirely)
pitta_rakta_wounds.dressing_removal_schedule: Twice daily — morning and evening — during Grisma and Sarad rtu

leaf_bandage_rules.for_vata_or_hemanta_sisira_rtu: Leaves with snigdha (unctuous) and usna (hot) guna
leaf_bandage_rules.for_kapha_or_usna_kala: Leaves with ruksa (dry) and usna (hot) guna
leaf_bandage_rules.indication: Chronic ulcers with less musculature and insufficient moisture

benefits_of_bandage: Helps with crushed/fractured bones and dislocated joints
Patient experiences less pain during movement when wound is bandaged
All 5 wound types (uneven, hard, soft, painful, painless) clean and heal faster with bandaging

ksara_karma.definition: Therapeutic application of caustic alkalies derived from combination of drugs of all tastes (predominantly pungent and salt), which are penetrating and hot in potency.
additional_benefits: Performs functions of excision, incision, extraction, scarification
ksara_karma.superiority: Ksara is superior to all sharp instruments because it can be used where instruments fail (nasal polyps, malignant tumors, chronic multi-dosha ulcers) and can be administered internally.

grades_by_potency.indications: Arbuda (tumors) and disorders caused by Vata, Kapha, and Medas

preparation.note: Use after 7 days; adjust dose to strength of disease

grades_by_potency.indications: Arbuda and diseases of moderate strength

preparation.physician_preparation: Must purify self, wear white clothes
preparation.primary_plant: Kala muskaka tree — healthy, middle-aged, branches spreading east or north
process_steps: Collect plants with roots, fruits, leaves, branches; cut into pieces
Burn plant material + limestone; collect ashes
Add 4x water + 4x cow's urine to ashes; stir well
Filter through thick cloth until clear, red, thick liquid is obtained
Cook precipitate on oven using snehapaka method

During cooking add: macerated limestone powder, paste of cock/peacock/falcon/heron/pigeon excreta, bile juice of animals and birds, haritala, manahsila, saindhava lavana, red-hot conch shell (cooled before adding)
Store in heap of barley for preservation

grades_by_potency.indications: Arsas (hemorrhoids) from Pitta and Rakta dominance

preparation.difference: Only macerated powder of limestone and conch shell added during cooking; no prativapa dravya paste

ideal_ksara_qualities.meaning: When dropped from a height, forms a small peak — not spread flat

body_regions: All eye diseases (EXCEPT disorders of the eyelids)

general: Patient sits or lies down; held tight by attendants
Diseased part is punctured, scratched, or cut by knife
hemorrhoids_guda_arsas: Apply through slit of proctoscope with metal rod
Cover proctoscope with hand after application
eye_lid_vartma_roga: Apply alkali thin as a lotus petal
nasal_polyps_nasa_roga: Alkali applied and left for 50 seconds

post_procedure_care: After stipulated time: remove alkali with a brush
Cover with paste of ksira + mastu + kanjika (sweet, cold potency) mixed with ghee
Give food and recipes promoting secretions and moistening of body
If burn site is deep-rooted: apply paste of dhanyamla + yasti + tila
Paste of tila + yastimadhu + ghrta heals ulcer

samyak_dagdha.label: Proper application
signs: Site assumes color of ripe jambu (Syzygium cumini) fruit

ati_dagdha.label: Excessive application
serious_complications: Excessive anus burning → obstruction or excess elimination of faeces/urine, impotency, death (injury to rectum)
Excessive nose burning → contraction of nasal bridge, loss of sense of smell
Excessive ear/sense organ burning → loss of normal function
management: Note: Sour substances are cold to touch and attain sweet taste by contact with alkaline substances — hence washing ksara wounds with sour substances is advised

agni_karma.definition: Therapeutic procedure conducted using fire or pertaining to fire. The highest-order para-surgical intervention in Ayurveda.
agni_karma.superiority_hierarchy: Agnikarma > Ksara karma > Sastra karma > Bhaisajya (medicine) — for stubborn conditions
agni_karma.key_property: Diseases managed by thermal cautery do not revert (no recurrence)

diseases: Tilakalika (black spots/moles size of sesame seed)
Dusta vrana (Chronic ulcers and suppurated wounds)
Profuse bleeding (where venesection was not properly conducted)

contraindications.persons: Same as Ksara karma contraindications (see ksara_karma.contraindications)
additional: Foreign body not removed from wound
contraindications.seasons: Should NOT be done in summer (Grisma rtu)
contraindications.emergency_exception: If emergency: first give cold treatments and unctuous food, then proceed

procedure_steps: Select eligible patient; perform spiritual rites
Patient lies comfortably on cot facing east; held tight by attendants
Heat instruments (jambavaustha salaka etc.) until tips are red-hot
Apply to body creating marks: semicircular, circular, cruciform, figure-8, point, straight line, dotted patch
Continue until proper signs appear: burning sound, foul smell, skin contraction
Keep patient calm with soothing words throughout
post_procedure_care: Apply ghee and honey to site
Apply pastes of unctuous and cold substances

types.name: Tuccha Dagdha
treatment: NEVER use cold substances (cold causes coagulated blood accumulation → increased pain)
Hot treatment → coagulated blood dissolves → pain subsides

types.name: Durdagdha
treatment: Conduct both cold and hot substance treatments
Followed by: washing wound with cold decoctions

types.name: Samyak Dagdha
signs: Skin color resembles ripened tala phala (palm fruit) or pigeon
treatment: Apply paste: tavaksiri + plaksa + candana (sandalwood) + gairika + guduchi — mixed with ghee
After burning sensation reduces: follow Pittaja Vidradhi treatment line

types.name: Ati Dagdha
types.treatment: Follow treatment prescribed for Pittaja Visarpa (Pitta-type erysipelas)

treatment_principle: Ama sopha: NEVER incise — manage medically
